description: 5 should-trigger + 5 should-not-trigger queries. Should-trigger imply a ruflo-equipped project needing swarm/orchestration delegation. Near-misses route to subagent-orchestration (in-session, no ruflo), mcp (generic), or a plain implementation skill.

queries.q: spin up a swarm to refactor this module — we have ruflo installed
use the ruflo swarm memory to find how we solved this before
coordinate several agents in parallel via claude-flow
delegate this multi-agent build to the orchestration runtime
spawn a coder and a reviewer agent through ruflo
run an implementer/judge pass on this diff in-session
add an MCP server to my project
how do I register a hook in settings.json?
review this PR for security issues
